Name: Simple Cursor
Author: xzqute
Description:
[center][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][u][color=#c27ba0][/color][/u][/font][/size][/center][center][/center][center][size=3]The [b]Simpler Cursor[/b] mod adds six new cursors so you can customize your game experience and make it more unique. The cursors include [b]Classic[/b], [b]Copper[/b], [b]Gold[/b], [b]Pink[/b], and [b]Iridium[/b], each with its own unique style and appearance.

Cursors can be changed at any time in the mod settings menu, allowing you to easily switch between them depending on your mood. For example, you can choose a gold cursor to emphasize your success in the game, or an iridium cursor to add exoticism to your gaming experience.
[/size][/center]

Downloads.Description:
- Fixed compatibility with 1.6
- Added new cursor selection type «Outline+Shadow»
